summary: community.general deprecations carried into Ansible 11: CmdRunner ignore_none in context, MH cause_changes on_success/on_failure, git_config list_all and state=present without value (use git_config_info), the hipchat module, and pipx below 1.7.0.
questions: How do I read git config values with community.general going forward?
Is the hipchat module still supported?
What minimum pipx version will be required?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (11.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `git_config`: `list_all` and `state=present` without `value` are deprecated. Use `community.general.git_config_info` to read.
- `pipx` / `pipx_info`: pipx older than 1.7.0 is deprecated.
- `hipchat` is deprecated (service discontinued).
- Dev-facing: CmdRunner `ignore_none` in context, and the MH `cause_changes` `on_success`/`on_failure` parameters.
